note: Local small models for the lm-<alias> arms (eval/localmodels.py). 'mlx' = an MLX model dir (used on macOS) or 'hf:<repo id>'; 'gguf' = a .gguf file for llama.cpp (used on Windows/WSL/Linux, needs `pip install llama-cpp-python` built with GPU support). Relative paths resolve against the checkout; models/ is gitignored. Override this file with ORION_LOCAL_MODELS=<path>.

orion-lm.about: C1 fine-tune of Qwen3.5-4B (trained on Orion's action format)

granite41-8b.about: Granite 4.1 8B instruct, 4-bit (spills past 4 GB of VRAM)
